A '''pin-up poster''' was put up on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It showed a [[Human/Legends|human]]<ref name="Lethal" /> [[Gender/Legends|female]]<ref name="Trivia">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/lethal-trackdown-trivia-gallery|text="Lethal Trackdown" Trivia Gallery|quote=The nightclub on Coruscant is filled with posters of various female pin-up models}} {{C|Slide 6}}</ref> posing in a tight, revealing [[Color/Legends|blue]] dress. The [[Painting/Legends|poster]] was put up at [[Terminal 24/Legends|Terminal 24]] in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]], and the [[Moshi Bar/Legends|Moshi Bar]].<ref name="Lethal" />
